description: Defines the Diff class in the Git namespace, providing functionalities for 'git diff' operations such as comparing commits and retrieving file differences.

classes.name: Diff
classes.description: A class providing services related to 'git diff' commands, including comparing commits and retrieving file hunks.

methods.name: getAllDifferentFiles
methods.description: Returns all files that differ between commits or between a commit and the working directory.

methods.name: getAllHunksForFile
methods.description: Returns all hunks (diff chunks) for a specified file.
